text: A prison term of three months to three years shall be imposed on anyone who, being authorized to process personal data, with a profit motive, causes a security breach to the databases under his/her custody.

A prison term of six months to five years shall be imposed on anyone who, for the purpose of obtaining an undue profit, processes personal data by means of deception, taking advantage of the error in which the data subject or the person authorized to transmit such data is found.
In the case of sensitive personal data, the penalties referred to in this Chapter shall be doubled. Article Four.- ........
